purpose: Declared candidate comparisons over the #421 lineage inventory. Each entry is a CLAIM about which two nodes to compare, under which runtime binding, with which design and which axes the treatment is allowed to change. The classification (controlled / system_comparison / historical_not_comparable / blocked) is DERIVED by scripts/provenance/training_comparison.py from the inventory bytes and is never written here.

designs.paired_siblings: two heads warm-started from the same node with the same budget after it; treatment = what the schedule (or cache/teacher) changes
designs.stage_increment: rhs is a warm-start descendant of lhs; treatment = the added stage as a bundle (its recipe, epochs, cache)
designs.seed_replicate: identical recipe and warm start, only the seed differs; measures training-seed variance
designs.runtime_ab: same checkpoint under two deployment artifacts; a runtime attribution, not a training one
designs.system: two different systems; the tool reports what differs, no training attribution is claimed

comparisons.intended_treatment: domain adaptation of the whole detector (gated-teacher training, 12 protocol epochs on MOT17 SDP) on top of external COCO pretraining
comparisons.question: 原始 pretrained YOLO26s vs domain-adapted teacher — the issue's '原始/後訓練系統對照' at the teacher level
notes: Both sides keep the native Detect head; the adapted side adds a gate module that is identity at deployment (gt_ratio 0).
The raw-YOLO runner on the shared tracker is not an inventory node (speed/baseline presets use 960-px e2e engines); deliverable 3 must bind it before this row is executable.
Per-detector threshold re-tuning is a separate optional variant; fixed-policy results must not be merged with it.
